uncovered_constraints_packaged: R09 owns only the CPU-only twelve-table analysis stage and consumes only the exact same-run R01-R08 prefix in workflow01-10-fresh-e2e.
The outer scheduler alone creates the formal R09 Goal; the project skill creates no nested Goal, invokes no Adapt or project skill, and starts no successor.
The pinned target is inspection-bound and immutable; target documentation and historical timings prove source bindings only and cannot populate R09 tables.
The authoritative workload is the row-zero 16-32K batch with two warmups and eight measured requests at concurrency eight, infinite request rate, and 1024 output tokens.
Every input, table, join, manifest, audit, and handoff retains devices 0 and 1, DP ranks 0 and 1, mapping 0-to-0 and 1-to-1, world size two, TP1, PP1, and DP2 mp.
The same-run cumulative ledger and all R01-R08 handoffs, transitive artifacts, run IDs, lineage IDs, request hashes, profile hashes, and topology fields are validated before analysis.
R07 non-replay time is the sole observed request, process, runtime, queue, and kernel clock through R10; R08 replay timing is diagnostic only.
R07 live samples, gap intervals, alignment anchors, collector latency, sequence, and uncertainty are normalized without deletion, interpolation, resampling, smearing, imputation, or zero fill.

Process live utilization is numeric only with at least three eligible true samples, no intersecting unobserved gap, and valid alignment uncertainty; unavailable is never interpreted as low utilization.
All timing uses integer-safe nanoseconds and half-open intervals, with exact request-relative offsets and deterministic end-before-start sweep-line ties.
The analysis contains exactly the twelve workflow-defined normalized tables and no hidden thirteenth table, Top-N truncation, sampling, or fixed event budget.
Kernel and queue concurrency are exact R07 sweep-line segmentations with active-membership hashes and union conservation, including per-rank and per-native-device identity.
Launch gaps use strict runtime/kernel correlation within exact request, rank, native device, queue/stream, and launch order; overlaps and unavailable states remain explicit.
High-latency processes use complete-denominator nearest-rank p95 global and comparable-group rules, retain all ties, and never use R08 replay duration.
Dependency nodes and edges preserve unresolved, cycle, host-only, no-kernel, missing-counter, unknown, and unavailable states rather than reconstructing from names or proximity.
Traffic/resource attachment uses exact logical identities, formulas, units, capability state, rank/device, physical capture IDs, and multiplicity conservation; shared raw capture is not multiplied.
Opportunity rows cover candidate, non-candidate, blocked-by-unavailable, and unknown states and never claim measured speedup, predicted speedup, root cause, or target-change authorization.
fresh_e2e_analysis.json seals path, byte size, hash, row count, ordered schema, schema hash, sort key, lineage, evidence class, and request/rank/device coverage for all twelve tables.
R09_SOURCE_LINEAGE.json seals every source, predecessor, tool, invocation, derivation, evidence class, repair revision, and no-execution declaration.

A separately invoked frozen CPU auditor independently checks row universes, joins, timing, utilization, concurrency, gaps, thresholds, dependencies, attachments, opportunity rules, manifests, and execution absence.
Failed and partial builder/auditor attempts are immutable and non-promotable; repairs use new roots and the same sealed R01-R08 bytes without any predecessor or device rerun.
Known large CPU builders/auditors require two consecutive fully stagnant five-minute observations before only a cmdline-verified scheduler-owned PID may be interrupted.
R09 produces full_request_analysis and source_lineage plus its twelve table hashes, artifact manifest, and completion audit, while the scheduler handoff remains separate.
Execution completion, evidence sufficiency, coverage, explicit unavailability, and next authorization remain separate; R10 advances only on the complete evidence gate.
The skill and this Adapt handoff are migration products and do not constitute R09 or performance-workflow execution.
